en.headline: Reports: HZMB Hong Kong Port to trial in-car clearance in December
en.dek: Immigration is preparing a Smart Passage pilot so registered private-car drivers and passengers can clear the border without leaving their seats or showing documents, several newspapers reported.
body: Several local newspapers reported that the Immigration Department plans to launch a Smart Passage pilot at the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port in December, allowing eligible private-car occupants to complete departure checks without leaving the vehicle or presenting identity documents.

According to those reports, the system would use multiple cameras and facial recognition with artificial intelligence to identify registered people inside the car at the same time. Ta Kung Pao said the arrangement is expected to be outlined in the Policy Address due on 16 September. The first phase would cover eligible Hong Kong permanent residents, with registration details still to be announced by Immigration.

The department in late June opened two non-stop e-Channel lanes in the port's departure hall, where registered Hong Kong permanent residents can walk through using facial recognition in about five seconds without showing an identity card or QR code. Private cars still undergo an in-car document check by an officer.

Immigration had not issued its own statement on the December vehicle pilot as of Tuesday morning. Details on who can register, which direction of travel is covered and how passengers will enrol remain to be confirmed by the department.

zh.headline: 據報港珠澳口岸12月試行車上智通行
zh.dek: 多份報章報道，入境處擬於12月在港珠澳大橋香港口岸推出「智通行」先導計劃，合資格跨境私家車司機及乘客毋須下車或出示證件即可過關。
body: 多份本地報章報道，入境事務處計劃今年12月在港珠澳大橋香港口岸推出「智通行」先導計劃，讓已登記的合資格跨境私家車司機及乘客安坐車內完成過關，毋須下車，亦毋須出示證件。
報道指，系統會以多鏡頭即時追蹤車內容貌，再以人工智能同時核對車內各人身份。《大公報》稱，行政長官預料於9月16日發表的施政報告中公布有關安排。計劃首階段對象為合資格香港永久性居民，登記辦法有待入境處公布。
入境處於6月下旬已在大橋口岸離境大堂開設兩條「無感e道」，已登記的合資格香港永久性居民可憑容貌識別在約5秒內完成出境檢查，毋須出示身份證或二維碼。現時私家車過關仍由入境處人員在車上查驗證件。
截至週二早上，入境處尚未就12月私家車先導計劃自行發稿。誰可登記、涵蓋出入境方向，以及乘客如何登記等細節，仍待當局正式公布。
